about: 2.51 (Mandeep, 10 Nov 2026: 'connect the websocket for charting, we need tick-by-tick and the price at the same time'): the chart's live stream. The app already receives every price change Upstox sends on its one live feed; this pushes them from the app to your browser over a websocket instead of the chart asking every 2 seconds. No new connection to any broker. every_ms: how often the app checks for a new price for an open chart (a price is sent only when it changed); max_streams: open charts at once; heartbeat_s: a still-alive message when nothing changes; reconcile_s: how often the chart also re-reads its last bars (volume and any missed bar). 2.69: prices_ms / max_price_streams: the Live page's own price stream (as fast as the chart); sec_syms / sec_keep: seconds candles (5s, 15s, 30s) kept for these symbols plus any symbol an open chart streams, today only.
